title: Sensor Check-In Gap Detection
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by device
| eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)
| where minutes_since>120
| sort - minutes_since
description: Finds battery sensors and sleepy devices that simply stopped checking in, which is often how low batteries or weak meshes first show themselves.
value: Offline sensors quietly rot automations from the inside; a gap detector is the simplest way to keep your dependency graph trustworthy.
implementation: Forward regular Zigbee2MQTT device reports; alert when a device stays silent beyond its normal reporting interval.
visualization: Table of devices by minutes since last seen.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which smart sensors have gone quiet long enough that they may be dead, asleep, or out of range.
